title: Breastmilk Storage Gear
body:
Nourishing your baby with breast milk is a beautiful journey, and ensuring its safe storage is key. This Momcozy milk storage gear collection simplifies breast milk storage with a range of milk storage solutions designed for every need.
Why do you need breast milk storage gear?
Breast milk is a vital source of nourishment and antibodies for your baby, and ensuring its safe and effective storage is paramount for continuing to provide these benefits even when direct breastfeeding isn't possible. Properly stored breast milk maintains its nutritional value and reduces the risk of contamination, allowing your baby to receive the best possible sustenance.

body:

Seven months after welcoming her baby boy, Jessica looks back on the physical and emotional realities of her journey into motherhood.
In this episode of Mom Truths 101, she opens up about the sciatic pain she experienced during pregnancy, the pressure she placed on herself to pump eight times a day, and the postpartum anxiety that left her struggling to sleep, eat, and trust herself as a new mom.
When pumping, holding her baby, and constantly washing parts became too much, support from her familyâand tools that fit her real lifeâhelped her find a routine that worked for both her and her baby.
Looking back, Jessica would remind herself to take a deep breath, give herself grace, and remember that a crying baby does not mean she is doing something wrong.
